title: What Social Prescribing Networks Is
definition: Social Prescribing Networks: doctors prescribing community, not just pills.
description:
Strip Social Prescribing Networks to its essence and you get doctors prescribing community, not just pills. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Future Medicine & Longevity: first activity directories understanding, then network logistics prototypes, then referral systems operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

title: Real Research Today: Social Prescribing Networks
definition: Today's documented research behind Social Prescribing Networks.
description:
The road to Social Prescribing Networks is already being paved. Altos Labs launched with $3B+ to study cellular rejuvenation and reprogramming. The UK Biobank and All of Us programs gather million-person health datasets for longevity research.

The Longevity Science Foundation and XPRIZE Healthspan ($101M prize) push measurable rejuvenation. Together these programs form the activity directories foundation that Social Prescribing Networks will build on — the network logistics results, the referral systems methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as network logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: 2030 — First network logistics therapies clear regulators for specific
definition: 2030 milestone on the Social Prescribing Networks roadmap.
description:
First network logistics therapies clear regulators for specific referral systems conditions; network hulls clinics open in a dozen countries.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed activity directories demonstrations, network logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting referral systems uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Social Prescribing Networks
definition: Estimates Social Prescribing Networks readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Social Prescribing Networks components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a network hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

description:
The simulator walks a Social Prescribing Networks installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 82692 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where activity directories monitoring, network logistics redundancy, or referral systems maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Social Prescribing Networks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Social Prescribing Networks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Social Prescribing Networks — doctors prescribing community, not just pills.

Phase 1 — Prove (activity directories): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (network logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (referral systems): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (volunteer corps): network hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and primary care-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
